h2. Steps to reproduce

# Create 2 instances Jira DC and Jira Cloud
# Prepare migration to the cloud without turning on the Allow JCMA migration toggle on Jira Cloud instance
# After the migration fails, go to Advanced settings on Jira Cloud
# Click on ‘Contact Support’ and ‘Read more’ buttons

*Actual outcome*

'Contact Support' and 'Read more' buttons do not work on the message toast after a failed migration. An error appears in the browser console: Blocked opening '[https://appfire.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/11'|https://appfire.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/11'] in a new window because the request was made in a sandboxed frame whose 'allow-popups' permission is not set.

*Expected outcome*

Clicking on 'Contact Support' button should open a new tab with the Appfire support page.
Clicking on 'Read more' button should open a new tab with the documentation page.

*Proposed solution*
Probably issue is caused by Jira recent changes to iframe permissions, we are not able to perform redirection directly but we have to use dedicated Jira service. It is handled by directive {{[spAppDocumentation]}}({{InAppDocumentationDirective}}). Probably it will be be enough to use this directive.

items.toString:
h2. Steps to reproduce

# Create 2 instances Jira DC and Jira Cloud
# Prepare migration to the cloud without turning on the Allow JCMA migration toggle on Jira Cloud instance
# After the migration fails, go to Advanced settings on Jira Cloud
# Click on ‘Contact Support’ and ‘Read more’ buttons

*Actual outcome*

'Contact Support' and 'Read more' buttons do not work on the message toast after a failed migration. An error appears in the browser console: Blocked opening '[https://appfire.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/11'|https://appfire.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/11'] in a new window because the request was made in a sandboxed frame whose 'allow-popups' permission is not set.

*Expected outcome*

Clicking on 'Contact Support' button should open a new tab with the Appfire support page.
Clicking on 'Read more' button should open a new tab with the documentation page.

*Proposed solution*
Probably issue is caused by Jira recent changes to iframe permissions, we are not able to perform redirection directly but we have to use dedicated Jira service. It is handled by directive {{[spAppDocumentation]}}({{InAppDocumentationDirective}}). Probably it will be be enough to use this directive.

h3. Refined by Resolver

resolver:refinement:v1:0e72d858-5ea4-42e8-8a9e-1c095e24b117

*Summary:* Fix 'Contact Support' and 'Read more' buttons on the failed JCMA migration toast so they open external links correctly instead of being blocked by sandboxed iframe permissions.

*Requirements:*

# Replace the current direct-redirection mechanism for the 'Contact Support' button with the {{spAppDocumentation}} directive ({{InAppDocumentationDirective}}), pointing to the Appfire support portal URL.
# Replace the current direct-redirection mechanism for the 'Read more' button with the {{spAppDocumentation}} directive ({{InAppDocumentationDirective}}), pointing to the relevant documentation page.
# No changes to other buttons, toasts, or links outside this specific failed-migration message toast.
# No changes to iframe sandbox permission configuration itself.

*Out of Scope:* Auditing or fixing other external-link buttons across the application; any redesign of the sandboxed iframe permission model.

h3. Acceptance criteria

* [ ] Reproduce the failure: prepare migration to cloud without enabling Allow JCMA migration toggle, let migration fail, go to Advanced settings on Jira Cloud.
* [ ] Clicking 'Contact Support' opens a new tab/window to the Appfire support portal, with no console errors about sandboxed frame popup blocking.
* [ ] Clicking 'Read more' opens a new tab/window to the documentation page, with no console errors about sandboxed frame popup blocking.
* [ ] No regression in other toasts/messages that use similar buttons elsewhere (spot-check, not full audit).

resolver:refinement:end
